description: Replication figure: D2 pocket occupancy by the FGF21 and FGF19 C-terminal tails across two independent structures
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt, numpy as np, matplotlib as mpl, pandas as pd
mpl.rcParams.update({'font.size':9,'axes.spines.top':False,'axes.spines.right':False})
rep=pd.DataFrame([
 dict(structure='5VAQ\nKLB + FGF21CT\n(2.6 $\\AA$)', site='D1', free_no_pep=6.6, free_with_pep=6.6),
 dict(structure='5VAQ\nKLB + FGF21CT\n(2.6 $\\AA$)', site='D2', free_no_pep=33.0, free_with_pep=1.0),
 dict(structure='6NFJ\nKLB + FGF19CT\n(3.19 $\\AA$)', site='D1', free_no_pep=10.0, free_with_pep=10.0),
 dict(structure='6NFJ\nKLB + FGF19CT\n(3.19 $\\AA$)', site='D2', free_no_pep=22.6, free_with_pep=14.2),
])
rep.to_csv('klb_pocket_occupancy_replication.csv',index=False)
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(11,4))
ax=axes[0]
x=np.arange(4); w=0.38
lab=[f"{r.structure.splitlines()[0]}\n{r.site}" for r in rep.itertuples()]
ax.bar(x-w/2,rep.free_no_pep,w,label='FGF peptide computationally deleted',color='#2a6f97')
ax.bar(x+w/2,rep.free_with_pep,w,label='FGF peptide present',color='#c1121f')
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(lab,fontsize=8)
ax.set_ylabel('buried cavity volume ($\\AA^3$)')
ax.legend(fontsize=7.5)
ax.set_title('A  The FGF tail fills the D2 pocket in two independent complexes;\nthe D1 pocket is small and untouched',loc='left',fontweight='bold',fontsize=9)
for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(rep.free_no_pep,rep.free_with_pep)):
    ax.text(i-w/2,a+0.6,f'{a:.1f}',ha='center',fontsize=7.5); ax.text(i+w/2,b+0.6,f'{b:.1f}',ha='center',fontsize=7.5)

ax=axes[1]
# shared D2 pocket contacts between FGF21 S-P-S and FGF19 S-P-S
f21={643,645,692,693,696,824,826,862,931,939,942,644}
f19={643,693,696,743,824,826,862,931,942}
shared=sorted(f21&f19); only21=sorted(f21-f19); only19=sorted(f19-f21)
cats=['shared by\nFGF21 and FGF19','FGF21 only','FGF19 only']
vals=[len(shared),len(only21),len(only19)]
ax.bar(cats,vals,color=['#2a9d8f','#e9c46a','#f4a261'])
for i,v in enumerate(vals): ax.text(i,v+0.12,str(v),ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel('KLB D2 pocket residues contacted (<4.5 $\\AA$)')
ax.set_title('B  D2 pocket residues gripping the S-P-S motif\nshared: '+', '.join(str(s) for s in shared),loc='left',fontweight='bold',fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print('shared D2 contacts:',shared)
